notes.title: The DLC "Dawn of Heroes" is officially released today!
notes.notes:
The main contents of this update are as follows: (April 16th, 10:00)  

I. Release of the 'Dawn of Heroes DLC'
The DLC will be released in three phases, with this being the first phase. The update includes:  

1. Tongquetai System
   1) Entry: Main City → Tongquetai (next to the Administrative Office).  
   2) The Tongquetai system features two functions: 'Hall of Heroes' and 'Prayer.'  
   3) In the Hall of Heroes, collected officer fragments are integrated to achieve milestones. Upon integration, players can view new officer artwork. Integrated officers are preserved outside the current game session (remaining effective even when starting a new game).  
   4) Officers in the Hall of Heroes form various bonds, each corresponding to a global effect in the Prayer system. Players can choose to activate these effects (with quantity restrictions).  

2. Troop Enhancement  
   1) Entry: Barracks → Enhancement.  
   2) Adds Tier 2 and Tier 3 enhancements for all existing troop types (excluding divine beasts and Xiang Yu's troops). Enhanced troops gain improvements in melee attack, ranged attack, melee defense, ranged defense, and destruction attributes, with stronger inter-troop countering effects.  
   3) Troops can be enhanced when their experience reaches 300, along with consuming a certain amount of money. Eligible troops include Tier 1 (Light Infantry, Light Archers, Light Cavalry), Tier 2 (Sword-Shield Soldiers, Spearmen, Heavy Crossbowmen, Armored Cavalry), and special troops from military tokens, but exclude barbarian troops.  

3. Two New Instances: [Northern Bandit Capital] and [Southern Bandit Capital]
   1) These Instances appear via 'Requests' the month after the player's faction controls ≥10 cities.  
   2) Introduces demonized officers as bosses, each with unique new skills.  
   3) Adds battlefield buffs that remain active throughout the Instance.  
   4) Victory rewards include Hall of Heroes officer fragments and activates special global effects: 'Shock · North' and 'Shock · South.'  
      - Shock · North: 27 northern cities are free from bandit raids for 2 years (24 turns).  
      - Shock · South: 31 southern cities are free from bandit raids for 2 years (24 turns).  

II. Base Game Updates
1. Official Rank System Update
   1) Official ranks now include troop capacity bonuses, increasing the total number of troops a player can command upon appointment.  

III. Bug Fixes
1. Fixed an issue where children could select books as training treasures.  
2. Fixed an issue where equipment enhancement skills failed to activate after equipping books on spirit generals.  
3. Fixed an issue where heroic officer Guo Jia's 'Speed March' skill caused abnormal action points in the next turn if no action was taken in the current turn.  
4. Fixed an issue with incorrect art resources for heroic officer Zhang Fei's horse.

Special Note:
 As the English localization is not fully completed, if this is a concern, we recommend waiting for future versions with improved and updated translations.

notes.title: The Feature DLC Releases on September 5th!
notes.notes:
Dear Lords,

Thank you for your patience! 'Three Kingdoms The Last Warlord' is about to welcome a new Feature DLC. It will be available on all platforms for 4 dollars. We plan to release the DLC in three phases, with the first phase scheduled for launch on September 5th. Let's take a closer look at the DLC's detailed content and development plan!

[b]The DLC includes the following features:[/b]

Hero Equipment Enhancement System:
1. Each hero's full set of 4 pieces of equipment can be enhanced together. When all four are enhanced to 1 star, the equipment skill is activated. Enhancing them to 2 stars and 3 stars will further improve the skill effects.
2. Enhancing hero equipment requires consuming special items called "Equipment Enhancement Talismans," a large amount of forging materials, and money.

Dispatch System:
1. A passive task system where you can assign idle heroes to various tasks by unlocking different dispatch missions.
2. Completing these missions rewards you with a large amount of money, food, forging materials, and enhancement talismans.

Children's Advanced Training System:
1. Forge a full set of exclusive equipment for your children who have become heroes (non-historical heroes).
2. The full set of exclusive equipment for children can be enhanced in the equipment enhancement system.
3. You can save trained children's heroes and their exclusive equipment outside the game (with quantity limits), and choose to bring them into a new game when starting over.

Advanced Forging System:
1. Further enhance divine weapons forged in the workshop to improve their attributes, adjust special abilities, and create sets.
2. You can save these enhanced weapons outside the game (with quantity limits), and choose to bring them into a new game when starting over.

[b]This DLC will be updated in three phases:[/b]

Phase One:
Hero Equipment Enhancement System:
  Updates for 12 heroes, including their equipment skills and corresponding equipment enhancements:  
  Han River Zhao Yun, White Horse Guan Yu, Goddess Zhen Ji, Return to Han Wen Ji, Fancheng Guan Yu, Tong Pass Ma Chao, Middle-aged Huang Zhong, Anti-Three Kingdoms Cao Chong, Shiting Jia Kui, Entrust Zhang Zhao, Guanzhong Zhong Yao, and Single Saber Lu Su.
  
Dispatch System:
  Updates for six major regions (Hebei, Central Plains, Jingchu, Bashu, Northwest, Wuyue), with 6 tasks for each region (1 general + 5 exclusive), totaling 36 dispatch tasks.

Phase Two:
Hero Equipment Enhancement System:
  12 new heroes will receive updates for their equipment skills and corresponding equipment enhancements, totaling 24.
  
Dispatch System: 
  4 new tasks for each region (2 general + 2 exclusive), adding up to 24 new dispatch tasks, completing the dispatch system.
  
Children's Advanced Training System:
  1. You can forge exclusive equipment for your children's heroes.  
  2. Trained children's heroes and their exclusive equipment can be saved outside of the game.

Phase Three:
Hero Equipment Enhancement System:
  The final 12 heroes will receive updates for their equipment skills and corresponding equipment enhancements, totaling 36, completing the hero equipment enhancement system.
  
Children's Advanced Training System:
  1. The complete set of exclusive equipment for children's heroes can be enhanced in the equipment enhancement system.  
  2. The children's advanced training system will be fully completed.
  
Advanced Forging System:  
  1. Divine weapons forged in the workshop can be further enhanced.  
  2. Enhanced equipment can be saved outside of the game.  
  3. The advanced forging system will be fully completed.

Q4 and 2019 Plans
notes.notes:
[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27528087/a6eea9d253e53d5c70856aa49dbdc8fc887a6b50.jpg[/img] 

A Letter to supporters
also a description of our follow-up plan

Foreword: Up to October 24, our studio’s indie strategy game "the Last Warlord" has sold more than 86,000 copies in the entire platform (PC + IOS). We would like to express our sincere thanks for your enthusiastic support. Now we share our follow-up development plan with you and give a brief explanation. 

1: Major update – art
In order to improve the overall quality of the game, we have now started a complete revolution of the interface.
1) New avatars.
2) New world map. 
3) New UI and icons.
4) New models of troops. 
5) New battlefields. 

2: Major update – music and sound effects
Currently, we are coordinating with professional music studios for a complete replacement of music and sound effects to enrich the music performance and enhance the game experience. 

3: Functions:
We want to realize the following functions: 
Note: The following content is arranged in no particular order. It is mainly based on human resource allocation, system relevance and difficulty. 
1) Debate System: presented in the form of a mini traditional Three Kingdoms card game. 
2) In-city system: In the main city, you can click on the buildings and enter them. They will be opened one by one. Now we give priority to Tavern and Market: 
A) The Tavern system：There are three buttons: [Rumors], [Banquet], [Interact] 
i) [Banquet]: You can invite several officials to drink. Banquet can improve their Loyalty and Intimacy with the ruler. The Intimacy between the participating officials can also be improved. 
ii) [Interact]: you can talk with, fete and give gifts to free officials who have been found through Exploration and have moved to your city to improve his Intimacy.  
B) Market system: ([Rumors], [Loan], [Trade]) 
i) [Trade]: You can invest in special products that your force has developed to increase its production. You can also purchase specialties here. 
3) Duel system: 1VS1 and many VS many will be available. Besides, it will be applied in the Skill Intrude. 
4) Automatic combat: a mini-game played in a chessboard, including troop formations. 
5) “Emperor of Han” system: You can pay tribute to the Emperor of Han and improve the relationship between your force and the royal court. Tribute point are accumulated, and with it, you can buy official positions, increase your Reputation, eliminate your Infamy and designate targets as the public enemies; (Note: the Emperor of Han can initiate a contest of martial arts). 
6) Optimization of strategic AI: We will add strategic AI for computers and optimize their internal and diplomatic strategies; 
7) Officers’ features V2.0: We will add special skills to famous officers (e.g. Guan Yu, Zhuge Liang). Generals and counsellors will be given different special tactics. 
8) Minister-Advice system: The three major ministers will give advices to the player from time to time, assisting the player’s decision-makings and operations. 
9) Multiple Endings: Depending on the statistics of your completed game, different endings will be reached. 
10) Ethnic groups, rebels and bandits: Rebels and bandits will harass and plunder your city randomly. You need to suppress them regularly. Occupying villages of ethnic groups can give you a certain period of steadiness.  
11) Provincial governor: You can appoint a provincial governor to administer multiple cities. This position is between the ruler and the prefect. 
12) Martyr's Shrine and the Title of Nobility: You can give a title to a deceased military commander posthumously. 
13) Steam Workshop will be available;
14) Assassin function: You can send swordsmen to perform assassination and rescue captures;
15) Optimization of game performance: Search events and Proposals will appear in progress. In addition, the monthly report briefing will be presented in the form of a chart. 
16) Haras and Press: They produce horses and books respectively. 
Conclusion: The above are the functions included in our follow-up development plan. By sending this letter to you, we want you know that we never stop. We are striding forward more confidently. We are determined to make "the Last Warlord" a milestone of Three-Kingdoms-themed stand-alone games and a new classic appreciated by you players!

notes.title: EA Version Patch No.25 (V0.1.0.4949）
notes.notes:
EA Version Patch No.25 (V0.1.0.4949）
【Add On】
01：English Version released.
Steam - Game - Properties - Language - Select English 

【Bug Fix】
Fix some bugs

We have just released 1st english version.
Please note, this english version only covers ui, basic command etc, and  you should be able to play without barriers

DOES NOT INCLUDE 
Officer bio, full description of  items, treasures etc. These documentary files are about 300000 - 400000 words in Chinese, that is s not easy for a tiny indie dev like us to translate at this moment. We will update one by one in the future.

We are sure there are still many bugs, spelling errors, grammar errors, so please leave your feedback, suggestion in the forum, we will fix them ASAP
http://steamcommunity.com/app/577230/discussions/1/

Some known issues about English 
So far, our program does not distinguish plural and singular, so you may see something may display like this
"Liu Bei and Zhang Fei is going to search" or 
"Liu Bei are going to search" 
We will trying to fix this kind of issues, but not easy at this moment, because programmer did not think about different language format, hope you could understand it.


The tutorial should be coming with next patch

Thanks for your support!

notes.title: 《汉末霸业》EA版24号补丁更新公告（V0.1.0.4761）
notes.notes:
《汉末霸业》EA版24号补丁更新公告（V0.1.0.4761）
今日补丁更新的内容如下：（再次强烈建议开新档游戏）
【BUG修复】
01：去掉误报的验证不完整弹窗BUG。
02：修改了内政轮崩溃的BUG。（主要是训练中部队被出战引发的一系列问题）
03：出征时，点击X掉空部队系统崩溃的BUG修复。
04：分城乱征兵的BUG修复。
05：【出征】给主将全选部队导致系统崩溃的BUG修复。
【功能优化和追加】：
01：陈情V2.0版本功能更新。（陈情指令取消，全部变为相应功能设施互动，陈情商人任务取消，因为真正的商人来访系统正在开发中。）
02：武将特性说明的完善。
03：上次遗留的部分技术全部开放，功能全部加载。
04：缺失的城市特性效果全面加载。
05：追加城市特性开启汇报功能。
06：追加霹雳车会打偏功能。
07：全兵种详细说明追加。
08：战斗AI全面优化V1.0版。
09：【出征】指令支持全势力都市任意出征模式。（分城可直接在此手动出兵，故方针里面的立刻出征按钮取消。）
另外，由于我们的测试人力的不足，所以如果还有反复，希望大家理解和支持，我们将及时修复和修正，另外由于难免有新旧程序代码冲突的地方。所以建议更新补丁后，如果发生系统冲突，则建议开新档重新游戏。

notes.title: Dev Update: English Language Support
notes.notes:
Dear Supporters:

Our current tasks are:
1) Busy to fix bugs (update daily)
2) Add new functions (update weekly)

notes.title: 《汉末霸业》Beta版 V0.1.0.2248 更新公告
notes.notes:
补丁内容如下：
01：存档/读取功能再次修正。
02：修正歼灭敌军后，主部队连续增加三次士气后系统崩溃的BUG。
03：修正电脑势力财政赤字问题依然可以运转的BUG。
04：修正出征时选择军团长和战场军团长显示不一致的BUG。
05：修正电脑出征带上全部钱粮的BUG。（改为只带三个月）。
06：修正战场中有可能出现的部队自动双倍速BUG。
07：修正全情报兵力和收支显示方面的问题。
08：修正多个军团参加同一场战斗的逻辑问题。
09：修正战场主界面显示部队数量的错误。
10：修正登庸武将时，出现的登庸/被登庸者者不同步回城的BUG。
11：追加出现新陈情的时候，卷轴的提示功能。
12：修正政务安排时，只看不操作右键返回就取消的逻辑错误。
13：追加训练部队，默认以经验未满优先排列的功能。
14：加载当玩家只有单城时，【移动】指令直接屏蔽的功能。
15：全面修复【卸甲归田】功能，解雇后士兵数可正确返回人口。
16：修正全势力界面，宝物图标穿出UI的错误。
17：修正攻城战时，地面部队【齐射】城楼上无效的BUG。
18：修正城楼部队向地面部队普通攻击（落石攻击），动画卡屏的BUG。
19：追加城墙上【闯阵】功能屏蔽。
20：修正放置拒马取消一次可以无限放的BUG。
21：调整【齐射】战法规则，改为每回合每只弓箭部队仅能响应一次。
22：修正出征时，选择舰船会造成系统崩溃的BUG。
23：主界面右下角。追加黄色【进行】按钮箭头图标。
24：修正分城国税上交收益改为实际到达都城时才汇报。
25：追加城内无军粮支撑军队消耗则会逃兵的功能。（士兵会逃兵为民）。
26：优化政务【一键委任】逻辑。

notes.title: 《汉末霸业》v0.1.0.1445 更新公告
notes.notes:
《汉末霸业》v0.1.0.1445 更新公告
本次更新是春节后的第一次更新，工作组针对春节期间玩家提出的意见和建议进行了整理，同时也整理了这期间收到的各种BUG汇报，我们选择了能复现和确认的BUG进行了修复。本次更新的主要内容包括：追加在野武将、追加陈情、修复部分逻辑和BUG。
具体更新内容如下：
一：追加了190年剧本 60位在野武将，全国各地区皆有武将可探索。
二：追加了部分陈情。
三：修改了电脑的好战AI。降低好战性。
四：修改的部分BUG和逻辑错误如下:
（01）：刘备进攻韩馥，韩出2支部队迎击，打完一场后撤军。另外一只韩馥部队到我方城边，再次出征后该支部队消失的BUG	
（02）：敌军行动直接踩进着火区域的BUG修正	
（03）：部队战法如火箭、齐射等未做判断，人皆可放的BUG修正。
（04）：伏兵成功后游戏停止响应的BUG修正 
（05）：往武将初始部队整合兵力，士气经验合并错误，直接按武将已编制的部队计算的BUG修正
（06）：武将情报-宗族里面仍有喜好武器修改为子女
（07）：在选择韩馥的时候，受到刘备方进攻，第一次选择不应战，第二次攻到城下选择应战之后，没有办法结束回合的BUG修正
（08）：敌方主将被火烧死后，一直打到最后战斗都无法结束的BUG修正
（09）：伏兵被反伤的BUG修正
（10）：奇数伤害都处理成偶数的BUG修正
（11）：AI路过伏兵被中断后仍然对远处部队进行攻击的BUG修正
